problems: Page budget exceeded on the Aztec Triple Alliance (13 pages against 5): its 12 shapes change at reign boundaries that only the reign pages date; the other owned states stayed within or one page over budget (the extra pages are the Aztec Empire, Itzcoatl and Tepanec War pages opened for the Triple Alliance). 24 distinct pages were opened; sources_total counts each dossier's list (36).

Cliopatria shapes are misplaced for Toltec (does not contain Tula), Michoacan 1305-1439 (misses Lake Patzcuaro), Tenochtitlan and Texcoco (neither contains its own city; all Valley of Mexico shapes miss the Mexico City cell) and the Aztec shape includes Tlaxcala (by 1482) and Metztitlan (from 1450); all are corrected in keyframe_review.

WebFetch summarises pages: quotes in notes are the tool's returned sentences, not verified against the raw page; Tepanec_War is a redirect to the Aztec Empire article; the Republic_of_Tlaxcala URL returned the article titled 'Tlaxcala (Nahua state)' (Confederacy of Tlaxcala).

The Aztec Triple Alliance starts 1428 and ends 13 August 1521; Tenochtitlan and Texcoco end 1428 and Azcapotzalco 1428 (same-year handoff). Cliopatria's Spanish Empire row starts in 1521 over Mexico; am-06 should carry the mirror events (occupation of Tenochtitlan Nov 1519 to Jun 1520, contest Aug 1520 to 13 Aug 1521, Tututepec March 1522, Michoacan 1522-1530).
